title: Pure Blackwing
summary: Blackwing and Black-Winged Dragon cards with generic staples, built to play the page's combo lines. Simoon places Black Whirlwind, Shamal places Black Feather Whirlwind, and Sudri and Vata turn a hand into Black-Winged Dragon and Assault Dragon. The Extra Deck is all DARK Synchros, because Simoon and Sudri lock you into them; the only outside card is Bystial Dis Pater, which the lines use as a generic Dragon Synchro.

allow.Bystial Dis Pater: Generic Level 10 DARK Dragon Synchro the page's lines climb into; no Bystial monsters.

exclude.Lightning Storm: Needs you to control no face-up cards, and the Whirlwinds stay face-up.
exclude.Pot of Prosperity: Banishes Extra Deck Synchros the deck needs.

main: Blackwing - Simoon the Poison Wind
With no monsters, banishes a Blackwing from the hand to place Black Whirlwind from the Deck, then Normal Summons without Tributing.
Blackwing - Sudri the Phantom Glimmer
Normal Summoned: searches a card that mentions Black-Winged Dragon; Tributes a monster for a Level 2 Tuner token.
Blackwing - Shamal the Sandstorm
Sends itself to the GY to place Black Feather Whirlwind from the Deck; returns a Blackwing from the GY when a Blackwing Synchro arrives.
Blackwing - Vata the Emblem of Wandering
Special Summons itself next to a Blackwing, then sends itself with non-Tuner Blackwings from the Deck totalling Level 8 to bring out Black-Winged Dragon.
Blackwing - Sharnga the Waning Moon
Special Summons itself while a 2000+ ATK monster is out; from the GY, destroys a card while you control a Blackwing Synchro.
Blackwing - Chinook the Snow Blast
Sends a Blackwing Synchro from the Extra Deck to the GY to cut and negate an opposing monster.
Blackwing - Zephyros the Elite
Once per Duel, revives itself from the GY by returning a face-up card to the hand.
Blackwing - Harmattan the Dust
Special Summons itself next to a Blackwing and adds that monster's Level to its own.
Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind
Tuner that Special Summons itself next to a Blackwing and halves an opposing monster's stats.
Blackwing - Zonda the Dusk
Summoned: bounces a monster; from the GY, summons a Level 5 or higher Blackwing from the hand or Deck.
Mulcharmy Fuwalos
Generic hand trap the page's lines use: draws a card for each opposing summon from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Black Whirlwind
Placed by Simoon: whenever a Blackwing is Normal Summoned, searches a weaker Blackwing.
Black Feather Whirlwind
Placed by Shamal: revives a Blackwing or Black-Winged Dragon whenever you Special Summon a DARK Synchro.
Blackwing - Twin Shadow
Shuffles a banished or GY Blackwing Tuner and non-Tuner back to bring out the matching Synchro; from the hand with two Blackwings out.
Black Shadow Squall
Counter Trap: spends a Black Feather Counter to negate a Spell or Trap, and resets from the GY with Black-Winged Dragon.
extra: Black-Winged Dragon
Turns effect damage into Black Feather Counters, then fires them off at an opposing monster.
Black-Winged Assault Dragon
Level 10, also summoned by banishing a Tuner Synchro and Black-Winged Dragon: burns 700 for each opposing monster effect, and with four counters wipes the field on their turn.
Blackwing Full Armor Master
Level 10: unaffected by other cards; marks monsters that activate effects, then takes or destroys them.
Assault Blackwing - Kusanagi the Gathering Storm
Newest support. Level 9: a Tuner when made with a Blackwing, gains its Synchro materials' ATK, and attacks every opposing monster.
Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight
Level 6: burns and weakens a monster on summon, and gives an extra Blackwing Normal Summon.
Blackwing - Boreastorm the Wicked Wind
Level 6 Synchro Tuner: sends a Blackwing from the Deck and copies its Level.
Assault Blackwing - Raikiri the Rain Shower
Level 7: destroys a card for each other Blackwing you control.
Blackwing Tamer - Obsidian Hawk Joe
Level 7: revives a Level 5 or higher Winged Beast and redirects attacks and targeting.
Blackwing Armor Master
Level 7: can't be destroyed by battle, and zeroes monsters it has marked.
Blackwing - Silverwind the Ascendant
Level 8: destroys two monsters with lower DEF when summoned.
Blackwing - Gram the Shining Star
Level 5: summons a Level 4 or lower Blackwing from the hand.
Assault Blackwing - Onimaru the Divine Thunder
Level 12 that can't be destroyed by card effects.
Assault Blackwing - Chidori the Rain Sprinkling
Level 7: grows with each Blackwing in the GY and revives a Winged Beast Synchro when destroyed.
Bystial Dis Pater
Generic Level 10 DARK Dragon Synchro: revives a banished monster and stops monster effects.
